text: In 3 of 5 books an adult makes the resolution possible (a tickle, a distracted injection, a 'yes'); in the other 2 the child resolves it (a plan and a catch; leaving Mud in the bath). Evidence: 3 of 5 works, small sample, confidence LOW. Proposal for `writing_guidance`: No change; record that adult-enabled endings are common in this population, and track agency as the corpus grows.
